tooling.message:
fix(hooks): keep the git hooks when npm replaces the tooling's package

## Intent

Commits with type errors passed now and then. The git hooks were gone: they lived in a folder inside the tooling's package, which npm replaces whenever the tooling moves to another commit. Git skipped the missing hooks without a word until the next npm install put them back.

## Key changes

- lernapps hooks installs the hooks in node_modules/.cache/lernapps/hooks, each a line that runs the package's hook, and moves an app from the old folder.
- A missing hook makes the commit fail instead of passing silently.
- lernapps update installs the hooks again after its npm install.
- The time of the pre-commit hook does not change.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The copies of the shared quiz app in the tests install the hooks in a later commit of this pull request.

tooling.reason: The browser fix of tooling#76, a topic of its own.
tooling.message:
fix(check): use an installed Chromium where Playwright's own is missing

## Intent

lernapps check downloaded Chromium although one was installed and the environment forbids downloads. The app's Playwright needs a newer build than the preinstalled one.

## Key changes

- When Playwright's own Chromium is missing and downloads are turned off, the check starts the newest Chromium in the browser folder and says so in one line. The end-to-end tests use the same one through the Playwright preset.
- Only when none starts does it download Playwright's own, also with one line.
- The end-to-end tests no longer run playwright install before every run.
- CI sets no such variable and downloads as before.

tooling.reason: Follows the browser fix, not the hook fix it completes, so it stays its own commit.
tooling.message:
test: install the hooks in the copies of the shared quiz app

## Intent

The hooks now live in the app's node_modules/.cache/. A copy of the shared quiz app links node_modules and so has no hooks.

## Key changes

- The test fixture installs the hooks in each copy, as npm install does.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Completes the hook fix earlier in tooling#76.
